interface.signature: def transform(A: str, B: str) -> int:

preconditions.description: Both input strings A and B must have at least one character in length.
The lengths of strings A and B must be equal; otherwise, transformation is impossible.

preconditions.expression: all(c in A for c in B)
preconditions.description: Every character in B must exist in A with the same frequency; otherwise, transformation is impossible.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or (return_value >= 0 and all(B[i] == A[(i - return_value) % len(A)] for i in range(len(B))))
postconditions.description: If transformation is impossible, return -1. Otherwise, return the minimum number of steps (k) such that B is a rotation of A where the first k characters of B are a prefix of the last k characters of A in reverse order of selection.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or (return_value >= 0 and all(B[i] == A[(i - return_value) % len(A)] for i in range(len(B))))
postconditions.description: The output is the smallest k where B is obtained by moving the first k characters of B to the front of A in reverse order of their appearance in B.
